questions.question: What is a responsible first step before sharing someone else's photo online?
A creator wants to use a song in a public video. What should they check?
choices: Whether they have permission or a license to use it
Whether the video is longer than a minute
Whether the file name is short

questions.question: What does a strong password mainly help protect?
Which action best protects personal information?
choices: Reuse a password on every site
Avoid posting a home address publicly

questions.question: A message urges you to click a strange link immediately. What is safest?
choices: Verify the sender and link before clicking

questions.question: What is a digital footprint?
choices: A mark left by a computer mouse
The trace of information and activity connected to a person online

questions.question: Which is an example of cyberbullying?
choices: Giving respectful feedback on a draft
Disagreeing once about a class project

questions.question: How should you respond if a classmate shares a hurtful post about you?
choices: Give the sender your account password
Save evidence and seek help from a trusted adult or platform

questions.question: What does copyright generally protect?
choices: Any image found in a search

questions.question: What is a Creative Commons license used for?
choices: Stating permissions for reuse under specified conditions
Proving an image is public domain

questions.question: Which source is usually the most appropriate to reuse without asking, while still checking its terms?
choices: A work explicitly released under a compatible reuse license

questions.question: Why should you cite media you use in a project?
choices: To prove the media has no owner
To prevent anyone from viewing it
To credit creators and help others locate the source

questions.question: What should a creator do when presenting an online claim as factual?
choices: Check it against reliable sources and provide context
Rely on the first search result
Assume a high view count proves it

questions.question: Which behavior shows respectful online collaboration?
choices: Edit a teammate's work without telling them
Give constructive feedback and acknowledge teammates' contributions

questions.question: Why are privacy settings worth reviewing?
choices: They guarantee nobody can save a post
They replace the need for strong passwords
They help control who can see or interact with shared information

questions.question: A photo is altered to make a person appear to do something they did not. What is the key concern?
choices: The image has too many pixels
The file uses a common format
The edit may mislead viewers and harm the subject

questions.question: What is phishing?
choices: A deceptive attempt to obtain sensitive information

questions.question: Which action helps make a media project accessible?
choices: Add accurate captions or a transcript for spoken content
Put essential meaning only in color
Make audio play automatically at high volume

questions.question: What should you do if an online service asks for information unrelated to its purpose?
choices: Provide it to unlock every feature
Post it in a public comment
Pause, question why it is needed, and avoid sharing unnecessarily

questions.question: How can a creator reduce the spread of misinformation in a media post?
choices: Check evidence, date, and original context before publishing
